::: {#exm-relu}

#### ReLU on the digits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
hidden_relu = torch.relu(first(x_test))
zero_share = (hidden_relu == 0).float().mean().item()
print(hidden_relu.shape, zero_share)
```

Applying the [ReLU](#def-relu) to the [pre-activation](#def-pre-activation)s of the first layer of @exr-two-linear,
for all `r py$n_test` test images,
gives a [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer) of [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width) 32 for each image.
`r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * py$zero_share)`% of its entries are exactly 0,
one for each negative pre-activation.

:::
